episode.episode_description: Meta, Roblox, and Quora are challenging their new safety classifications under the UK's Online Safety Act. We look at why these platforms are heading to the Upper Tribunal and what it means for the future of digital regulation.

selected_story.source_title: Meta challenges Ofcom's OSA categorization of WhatsApp and Instagram imposing additional regulations; Roblox and Quora are also challenging their categorization (Daniel Thomas/Financial Times)
